title: Notation spec: Tic-Tac-Toe grid labels
description:
Tic-Tac-Toe notation — trivial, covered by Layer 1 label mapping.

## Grid labels (already in definition)
files: ["a","b","c"], ranks: [1,2,3]
Moves: a1, b2, c3, etc.

## Alternative: numeric
Just use 1-9 mapping to cells (common in casual play):
1=a1, 2=b1, 3=c1, 4=a2, 5=b2, 6=c2, 7=a3, 8=b3, 9=c3

## Declarative spec
No notation block needed — Layer 1 label mapping handles it.
The existing grid labels in the definition are sufficient.
